m: पात्रिन् mfn. possessing a drinking-vessel or a dish, Mn. vi, 52
having fit or worthy persons, W.
a: पात्रिन् — a. 1 Having or provided with a drinking-vessel. --2 Having fit or worthy persons.

v: tri॰ pAtramarhati Ga । pAtrArhe pakze yat । pAtryatatrArTe ।
m: पात्रिय mfn. worthy to partake of a meal, TS. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 1, 68).

s: pAttraM

klI, (patatIti । pata + kvip । pataM aDaHpatantaM janaM trAyate । trE + kaH । tataH svArTe prajYAdyaR nimne'sya niruktiSca darSanIyA .) pApitrAtA । yaTA, BavizyapurARe । “sarvvazAmeva pAttrARAM paraM pAttraM maheSvaraH । patantaM trAyate yasmAdatIvanarakArRavAt ॥” maheSvara iti pradarSakaM hetoraviSezAt । taTA nandipurARam । “pAttrARyADyAtmikA muKyA viSudDAScAgnihotriRaH । devatASca taTA muKyA godAnaM hyetaduttamam ॥” iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥
v: na॰ patati pata--kvip pataM patantaM trAyate trE--ka svArTe prajYAdyaR । pApitrAtari “sarvezAmeva pAttrARAM paraM pAttraM maheSvaraH । patantaM trAyate yasmAdatIva narakArRavAt” nandipu॰ । maheSvara iti pradarSakaM hetoraviSezAt “pAttrARyADyAtmikA muKyA viSudDAScAgnihotriRaH । devatASca taTA muKyA godAnaM hyetaduttamam” prA॰ ta॰ ।

s: pAttratA

s: pAtukaH

v: tri॰ pata--ukaY । 1 patanaSIle 2 prapAte 3 jalahastini ca medi॰ ।
m: पातुक mfn. falling or apt to fall (= पतनशील, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 154)
falling down, Śiś. iii, 3
losing caste or going to the lower regions, MBh. xii, 3444
पातुक m. a precipice, L.
an aquatic animal (= जलहस्तिन्), L.
N. of a poet, Cat.
a: पातुक — a. (की f.) [पत्-उकञ्] 1 Falling habitually or frequently. --2 Apt or disposed to fall. --3 Losing one's caste. --4 Going to hell. --कः 1 The declivity of a mountain, a precipice. --2 The water-elephant.
